thread:
sasha-support: FYI customer (org: org_8X4) opened ticket — token cost dashboard shows $0 / NaN rows for some subaccounts. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/12345
anika-eng: Can you paste org id + timeframe? Is this only US region?
sasha-support: org_8X4, affected range 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12, several subaccounts show $0 or NaN in "token cost" column. CSV attached in ticket. Customer says API usage looks normal.
mike-data: Sounds like aggregation join to price table returned NULLs. Running quick lookup...
mike-data: Query I ran:
```
SELECT org_id, subaccount_id, SUM(token_count) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM usage_rollups
WHERE org_id='org_8X4' AND day BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
Result: tokens present, cost = NULL for 3 subaccounts -> shows as NaN in UI.
josh-platform: Any recent schema changes or rollouts to ledger join? We shipped agg-pipeline v2 yesterday (canary -> prod).
maya-pm: Noted, canary was promoted at 03:05 UTC. Customer report timestamp ~10:20 UTC
sam-sre: Paging deploy-bot for deploy trace
deploy-bot: deploy: agg-pipeline v2 promoted to production by @josh-platform at 2026-03-11T03:05:12Z — job id: #agg-20260311-02
emma-enginfra: I see backlog job that enriches price lookup (price_rollup_worker) failed 03:15 UTC on 2026-03-11 with DB timeout. Logs: 'could not serialize access due to concurrent update'
mike-data: That would leave price_id NULL on rollups, causing join to pricing table to miss and set cost NULL. Quick fix: backfill price_id and recompute cost for affected days.
anika-eng: Can you share repro steps for support to confirm impact? Sam, can you run the backfill in staging and share DRY-RUN output?
sam-sre: Running dry-run patch job (no write): `python infra/scripts/recompute_costs.py --org org_8X4 --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-12 --dry-run`
sam-sre: Dry-run output: would update 3 rows, set cost to non-zero values. Sample:
```
org_8X4, sub_42, tokens=137500, old_cost=NULL, new_cost=125.42
org_8X4, sub_56, tokens=45000, old_cost=NULL, new_cost=41.12
```
maya-pm: Customer impact: these are billing-view only — customers see $0/NaN and alerts tripped. Need to schedule backfill and notify.
sasha-support: I'll reply to ticket with explanation and ETA pending backfill.
anika-eng: Plan: 1) fix price_rollup_worker to retry on serialization errors 2) run backfill for affected orgs 3) add assertion in agg pipeline to never emit NULL cost. I'll open PR for #1 and #3.
emma-enginfra: Backfill run scheduled 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC, will monitor.
billing-bot: Billing alert: alert 9876 triggered for org_8X4 at 2026-03-11T10:25:00Z — token-cost-zero-count > 0
sasha-support: Customer updated: they've paused outgoing billing emails until we confirm. Please prioritize.
anika-eng: Acknowledged. Will escalate if backfill shows mismatches.
joe-ops: quick question — is this limited to open-source models where price mapping was introduced in v2?
mike-data: No, pricing mapping applies to both curated and open models; issue is missing price_id on rollups, not model family.
josh-platform: After backfill we should publish a short postmortem and add metric to detect drops in price_join_rate.
sasha-support: Thanks everyone. I'll update ticket when backfill completes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: backfill job started 2026-03-12T02:00:05Z job id #backfill-993
sam-sre: backfill finished 2026-03-12T02:08:34Z — 3 rows updated, UI should reflect new costs within 5m
sasha-support: Confirmed with customer — dashboard now shows correct $125.42 etc. Closing ticket after billing confirms no further discrepancies.
maya-pm: Adding to roadmap action items: improve price_join_rate dashboard and alert, add retry logic to price_rollup_worker.
